sources.changes: Retain observation, decision, bounded change and feedback from the HumanLayer control loop. Inspection-only requests produce observations and recommendations; authorized implementation decisions pass through spec/plan and build before rendered re-observation. No recurring CI/controller/PR system is installed.

team_adaptation.changes: Forked from the copyable single-person collection at commit 082edfd. Retains fixed upstream method excerpts and licenses unchanged. Adds collection-synthesized team task ownership, assigned contributor scope, shared-artifact maintainers, isolated checkouts, handoff facts, integrated-version verification and designated release execution. Role names do not grant authority or exclusive task claims; existing project tools and authorizations apply.

adaptive_team_adaptation.changes: Collection synthesis for team-scoped automatic role continuation and repair/recheck; task/version/subset checkpoints confirmed by the person authorized for that matter; recovery of pending/partial confirmations; phase-aware document and experiment review with actual maintainer plus role routing; goal/impact/scale selection, contextual reading and integrated-version evidence. Does not grant authority over another member or add runtime, approval or synchronization services. Fixed upstream sources and prior team adaptation remain unchanged.

review_fixes_adaptation.changes: Collection synthesis clarifying evidence-based withdrawal of false review findings by the current review-record maintainer, with version/reason/counterevidence and repair-assignment removal; genuine or disputed other-owner defects remain open. Checkpoints depend on actual unknowns, impact, recovery cost, verification dependencies and batch-delivery needs; multiple files/functions alone are insufficient. Clear local reversible migrations verifiable in one batch continue under existing task authorization. Existing stops and major decisions remain effective; no new runtime or authority is added.

handoff_completeness_adaptation.changes: Clarify reproducible handoff: retrievable commit or baseline plus complete staged/unstaged changes, required new and binary files, retrieval location and manifest/snapshot identity; recipient reconstructs and checks in isolation before integration. No upstream bytes changed.

reliability_proportional_sync.changes: Adapt reviewed rnd-workflow reliability and proportional-workflow rules to actual maintainers, assigned scope, complete handoffs and integrated evidence. Matt Pocock inspiration is user-provided summary, not imported or independently verified upstream text. Preserve existing team rules and fixed upstream bytes.
